CheckTitle: EC2 instances non-compliant with Systems Manager patching requirements
Description: SSM-managed EC2 instances have not applied required security updates by reporting their patch compliance status against defined baselines.
Risk: Non-compliant, unpatched instances expose known vulnerabilities, enabling remote code execution and data breaches, which directly threatens the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of your systems.

Recommendation.Text: Adopt automated patch management with Systems Manager by defining strict patch baselines and promptly installing critical updates, complemented by defense-in-depth practices like staged rollouts and compliance alerting.
